---
title: "Overview"
---

## Context

This report presents the segmentation quality control for Xenium data,
comparing two segmentation methods:

- **Xenium**: 10x Genomics multi-modal cell segmentation
- **Proseg v3**: transcript-based cell segmentation

## Methods

| Method    | Description                              |
|-----------|------------------------------------------|
| Xenium    | Official 10x multi-modal segmentation   |
| Proseg v3 | Transcript assignment-based segmentation |

## Report structure

1. **Baseline** — core metrics (cells, transcripts, genes)
2. **Morphology** — cell shape and size
3. **Clustering stability** — cluster coherence
4. **Contamination** — region similarity, border admixture
3. **Volume (3D)** - z-dimension metrics
5. **Supervised** — consistency with scRNA-seq reference *(optional)*
6. **Summary** — comparative table and recommendation
